ms.report:
DevX Wallet - Milestone 1 Report
Overview
This report summarizes the completion of Milestone 1 for the DevX Wallet project, focusing on project initialization and planning stages as per the requirements specified by Catalyst reviewers.
Milestone Outputs
1. Finalize Project Scope and Requirements
・Scope Definition: We have clearly defined the project scope, focusing on developing a specialized wallet tailored for Cardano developers and support personnel. The wallet will include advanced features like wallet debugging tools, direct wallet creation, keyphrase exporting, detailed transaction overviews, UTXO listings, and CIP-30 debugging capabilities.
・Requirements Documentation: All key objectives and deliverables have been documented, ensuring they align with the goals outlined in the DevX Wallet Proposal.

2. Assemble the Development Team and Assign Roles
・Team Formation: The development team has been assembled with members whose skills align with project needs.
・Pascal: Project Manager & Head of Development
・Josh: Blockchain Expert & Developer
・Paul: UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer
・Roles Assignment: Specific roles and responsibilities have been assigned to each team member, and they have acknowledged their tasks.

3. Develop a Detailed Project Plan and Timeline
・Project Plan Creation: A comprehensive project plan has been developed, outlining all phases, milestones, tasks, and timelines.
・Timeline Overview:
・Project Initialization & Planning: 1 month (Completed)
・Prototype Development: 2 months
・Pilot Phase: 1 month
・Beta Phase: 1 month
・Final Phase: 1 month

4. Set Up Project Management and Collaboration Tools
・Tools Implemented:
・GitHub: For version control and code collaboration.
・Trello: For task management and progress tracking.
・Slack: For real-time team communication.
・Google Drive: For document sharing and collaborative editing.
・Configuration: All tools have been configured, and team members have been granted appropriate access permissions.

5. Conduct

ms.promise:
Develop the Initial Prototype of the DevX Wallet: Create the first working version of the DevX Wallet, focusing on implementing the foundational architecture and core functionalities.
Implement Core Features: Integrate the following essential features into the prototype:
・Advanced User Wallet Debugging: Tools and interfaces that allow users to debug their wallets effectively.
・Quick Wallet Creation: A streamlined process for users to create new wallets efficiently.
・Keyphrase Exporting: Secure mechanisms for users to export their keyphrases.
・Detailed Transaction Overviews: Comprehensive views and histories of all transactions.
・Listing Detailed Wallet UTXOs: Detailed listings and management of Unspent Transaction Outputs (UTXOs) for each wallet.

Conduct Initial Internal Testing: Perform thorough internal testing of the prototype to identify and fix major bugs, ensuring that the core functionalities work as intended.
Prepare Documentation for the Prototype: Develop detailed documentation that explains the prototype’s features, functionalities, and usage guidelines.
ms.criteria:
Prototype Developed with Core Features Implemented: The prototype must include all the core features outlined, demonstrating basic functionality and user interface.
Initial Testing Completed with Critical Bugs Resolved: Initial internal testing should be completed, and all critical bugs must be identified and resolved to ensure a stable prototype.
Documentation for the Prototype Available: Comprehensive documentation should be available, detailing the prototype's features, setup instructions, and usage guidelines.
Continuous Release of Source Code for Prototype: The source code for the prototy
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
We have now completed the development of our new wallet with the features required for this milestone. The entire code has been open-sourced in our repository: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/cardano-devx-wallet, where we have also added an extensive README.md: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/cardano-devx-wallet/blob/main/README.md. In addition, we have created a release of the wallet with installation instructions for Google Chrome: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/cardano-devx-wallet/releases/tag/v0.1.0-ms2
Moreover, we have prepared documentation in PDF format that presents the different wallet features: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lcwWMPCyVX6AMFtk5wIAx1_3h13BFzR4/view?usp=share_link. For your convenience, we have also prepared a video that showcases the wallet and highlights its core features: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SGwPZjw7RK-42If56Gw9wpQfpzr2bhbY/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
Launch a Pilot Phase with a Select Group of Developers and Support Personnel: Initiate the pilot phase by engaging a select group of developers and support personnel who will use and evaluate the DevX Wallet prototype. This phase is critical for gathering real-world usage data and identifying any practical issues.
Collect Detailed User Feedback and Identify Areas for Improvement: Implement a systematic approach to collect detailed feedback from pilot users. This feedback will focus on user experience, feature functionality, and any encountered issues.
Provide Support and Training to Pilot Users: Offer comprehensive support and training sessions to the pilot users to ensure they understand how to use the DevX Wallet effectively and can provide informed feedback.
Analyze Feedback and Prioritize Feature Enhancements and Bug Fixes: Review and analyze the collected feedback to identify common issues and areas for improvement. Prioritize these findings to guide the next phase of development, focusing on feature enhancements and critical bug fixes.
ms.criteria:
Pilot Phase Successfully Launched: The pilot phase must be officially initiated, with the selected group of users actively using the DevX Wallet.
Feedback Collected from Pilot Users: Detailed feedback should be collected from all pilot participants, providing insights into their experiences and suggestions for improvement.
Support and Training Provided to Pilot Users: Pilot users must receive adequate support and training to ensure they can use the wallet effectively and provide meaningful feedback.
List of Prioritized Enhancements and Bug Fixes Based on Feedback: A documented list of feature
